evidence: The solutions explicitly use a "0/1 bipartite color" array, build an "adjacency" graph, and assign alternating colors; qwen also handles "No constraints, assign all to 1 for lex smallest".
affordance_in_statement: Each valve must be configured to an operating pressure level of either 1 or 2. ... For a sensor to yield a valid reading, the sum of the pressure levels of the two valves it bridges must be exactly 3.
removal_suggestion: There is no semantics-preserving way to remove the reduction: it is the core structure of the task. To obscure the shortcut, replace the explicit sum-equals-3 sentence with an endpoint compatibility table describing which ordered pairs of pressure levels produce a valid sensor reading, without using the words 'sum', 'opposite', or 'bipartite'.
